```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
atus_con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/atus.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_act <- tbl(atus_con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(atus_con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(atus_con, "activity_codes")
dbplyr_codes |>
  collect() |>
  print()
table_counts <- tibble(
  table = c("activities", "respondents", "activity_codes"),
  rows = c(
    dbplyr_act |> summarise(rows = n()) |> collect() |> pull(rows),
    dbplyr_resp |> summarise(rows = n()) |> collect() |> pull(rows),
    dbplyr_codes |> summarise(rows = n()) |> collect() |> pull(rows)
  )
)
print(table_counts)
dbplyr_act |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  count(major_name, sort = TRUE) |>
  collect() |>
  print()
dbplyr_act |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(duration_min)) |>
  group_by(major_name) |>
  summarise(avg_duration_min = mean(duration_min)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_duration_min)) |>
  collect() |>
  print()
dbplyr_resp |>
  count(sex, employment_status) |>
  collect() |>
  print()
dbplyr_resp |>
  count(year) |>
  collect() |>
  arrange(year) |>
  print()
weekday_not_labor_force <- dbplyr_act |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_resp |>
      filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
      select(tucaseid, sex),
    by = "tucaseid"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(duration_min)) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarise(minutes = sum(duration_min), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()
print(weekday_not_labor_force)
activity_avg <- weekday_not_labor_force |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarise(avg_daily_min = mean(minutes), .groups = "drop")
print(activity_avg)
```

```{r}
keep_cats <- c(
  "Personal Care Activities",
  "Household Activities",
  "Caring For & Helping Household (HH) Members",
  "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure"
)

hourly_avg <- dbplyr_act |>
  mutate(hour = start_hhmm %/% 100L) |>
  filter(hour >= 6L, hour <= 23L) |>
  left_join(dbplyr_codes |> select(activity_code, major_name), by = "activity_code") |>
  filter(major_name %in% keep_cats) |>
  inner_join(
    dbplyr_resp |>
      filter(str_starts(employment_status, "Not"), day_type == "Weekday") |>
      select(tucaseid, sex),
    by = "tucaseid"
  ) |>
  group_by(sex, hour, major_name) |>
  summarise(avg_min = mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()
print(hourly_avg)
```

```{r}
ggplot(hourly_avg, aes(x = hour, y = avg_min, fill = major_name, group = major_name)) +
  geom_area() +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 23),
    labels = c("6 AM", "9 AM", "12 PM", "3 PM", "6 PM", "9 PM", "11 PM")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How the Weekday Fills Up",
    subtitle = "Average minutes spent in each major activity category by hour and sex",
    x = "Time of day",
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Major activity category",
    caption = "Source: BLS American Time Use Survey; weekday respondents not in the labor force"
  )
```

```{r}
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  mutate(major_name = fct_reorder(major_name, avg_daily_min)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_daily_min, y = major_name, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "How Non-Employed Americans Spend Weekdays",
    subtitle = "Average daily minutes by major activity category and sex",
    x = "Average minutes per weekday",
    y = "Major activity category",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: BLS American Time Use Survey; weekday non-employed respondents"
  )
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score) |>
  filter(!is.na(`2015`), !is.na(`2023`)) |>
  mutate(score_change = `2023` - `2015`)
state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023), !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, year, rla_score) |>
  collect() |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = rla_score) |>
  filter(!is.na(`2015`), !is.na(`2023`)) |>
  mutate(rla_change = `2023` - `2015`)
print(state_change |> arrange(rla_change))
```

```{r}
rla_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  collect()
district_count <- nrow(rla_2023)

ggplot(rla_2023, aes(x = rla_score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of 2023 Reading Scores",
    subtitle = paste("Number of districts:", district_count),
    x = "Reading score",
    y = "Number of districts",
    caption = "Source: SEDA 2025 district scores"
  )
```

```{r}
score_change_plot <- score_change |>
  mutate(
    rla_change = score_change,
    change_direction = if_else(rla_change > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
  )

ggplot(score_change_plot, aes(x = rla_change, fill = change_direction)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Number of districts:", nrow(score_change_plot)),
    x = "Reading score change",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change",
    caption = "Source: SEDA 2025 district scores; change is 2023 score minus 2015 score"
  )
```

```{r}
state_change_plot <- state_change |>
  arrange(`2023`) |>
  mutate(
    state_name = fct_inorder(state_name),
    change_direction = if_else(rla_change > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
  )

ggplot(state_change_plot, aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = `2015`, xend = `2023`, yend = state_name, color = change_direction),
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.12, "inches"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = `2015`), color = "gray50", size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Positive = "#168aad", Negative = "#d1495b")) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes, 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "Arrows begin at each state's 2015 score and end at its 2023 score",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Direction",
    caption = "Source: SEDA 2025 state scores"
  )
```
